content.short: Biconomy provides the leading account abstraction toolkit for smart contract wallets, enabling gasless transactions and seamless Web3 UX on Mantle.
content.description: Biconomy is a leading account abstraction and Web3 user experience infrastructure provider whose Modular Smart Account (MSA) framework enables developers to build wallets with gasless transactions, multi-chain session keys, and social login. The Biconomy Paymaster allows dApps to sponsor gas fees for their users, removing one of the biggest friction points in Web3 adoption. Founded in 2019, Biconomy has processed tens of millions of transactions and supports Mantle Network.
content.meta: Biconomy provides account abstraction and gasless transaction infrastructure for Web3 apps on Mantle. Discover Biconomy on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
